messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: prefilling OOMs detected on gpu-pool-3 (us-west-2). 18 container restarts in last 10m, error=CudaOutOfMemory. Paging: @sre_tom and @oncall-jordan.

lena: seeing `%CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY%` in prefill logs + container restart loop on node gpu-3b-12. Long prompts + kvcache growth. customers using large-context endpoints spiking.

dinesh: confirmed. Stacktrace shows repeated allocation failures during kvcache->prefetch. Sample: `runtime error: CUDA allocation failed: out of memory at 0x7f8a...`

sre_tom: oncall ack. I'll take pager. Initial mitigation: throttle max_prefill_tokens for hosted API route `chat-large-context` to 4k, switch to conservative batching. Applying now.

eng_runtime: pushing a hot-config: set `max_context_tokens=4096` and `auto_kvcache_eviction=true` for gpu-pool-3. Also enable fallback to `chat-large-coldmodel` when allocation fails.

lena: logs show container restarted after kernel error `GPU kernel timeout` then `Segmentation fault`. Might be memory fragmentation + long-lived KV.

dinesh: can we temporarily disable aggressive prefetch for long-context customers? We have a prefetch parameter `prefetch_window=2048` — propose set to 512.

sre_tom: doing staged rollout to gpu-pool-3 (10% -> 50% -> 100%). If noisy node identified, will cordon.

oncall-jordan: tagging customer ops for potential impact. @customer_ops pls draft customer note if outages extend >30m.

customer_ops: acknowledged. Pulling affected customer list from request logs (route=chat-large-context, env=prod). Tentative message: "We're investigating elevated errors on large-context chat endpoints; mitigation in progress."

eng_runtime: quick command I'm running on infra: ``kubectl -n redwood set env ds/prefill-runtime PREFETCH_WINDOW=512 MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=4096 --selector=gpu-pool=gpu-pool-3`` will patch DaemonSet rollout.

lena: after first 10m of throttle, restarts dropped from 18->5. Some nodes still flapping (gpu-3b-12). Marking it noisy.

dinesh: hypothesis: long prefix + continuous KV growth plus our continuous batching is causing fragmentation and OOMs. Recommended: enable `kv_trim_on_restart=true` and reduce contiguous batch sizes for large-context routes.

sre_tom: cordoned gpu-3b-12. Draining and moving active pods to spare-gpu nodes. Scaling hotpool +2.

oncall-jordan: what's customer impact? any 5xx spike?

lena: spike in 5xx and increased latency for route chat-large-context. Estimated impacted requests ~1.2k in last 15m, percent error ~4.8%.

customer_ops: drafting status page update: "Investigating increased errors/latency for large-context chat; mitigation underway. We will post updates every 30 minutes."

eng_runtime: rolled fallback policy: when CUDA OOM is detected, route to `chat-large-coldmodel` with lower memory profile (quantized) and add notice to clients: `retry_with_cold_model=true`. Pushing config now.

dinesh: added a short-term circuit breaker: if route error rate >3% for 5m, reject incoming requests >6k tokens with 429 and include advice to shorten prompts.

sre_tom: evictions continuing to drop. restarts last 5m = 0 on cordoned nodes, overall pool restarts down to 1. Good.

oncall-jordan: handing off to next oncall @oncall-jordan for monitoring during night rotation. Please keep incidents channel updated.

customer_ops: status page live: "Mitigation applied: throttling long prefill, enabling fallback to cold model. Errors reduced; investigating root cause and long-term fix."

lena: capturing traces + perf profile for failing pods. Will upload kernel traces to the incident runbook.

dinesh: next steps for eng: reproduce with long prompt synthetic load, exercise kvcache prefetch code, add defensive allocation checks and graceful fallback before OOM.

sre_tom: final note: patch deployed and cordon + drain completed. Monitoring for 60m. If error rate remains <1% we'll close pager.

oncall-jordan: ack. Leaving bridge open for 30m. Thanks team :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity=minor -> monitoring. page resolved for oncall rotation."
